summary: Retest completed for payroll/kasbon regression and mobile UI flows. GET /api/payroll returns 200, multi-entry dated kasbon behavior works with period-scoped deduction, owner Gaji cards/modal render, and employee filter interactions remain responsive.
action_items: No blocking regression found for requested scope; keep monitoring payroll and kasbon period logic in future iterations.
Align frontend API env key usage with platform rule (currently src/api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; rule expects EXPO_BACKEND_URL/Constants extra).
QRIS flow is MOCKED and remains out of scope in this retest.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts hardcodes process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL instead of the expected EXPO_BACKEND_URL convention from project rules.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows passed; no blocking UI/integration defects in tested scope)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Cleanup script scanned recent kasbon periods and found no residual TEST_ records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Verified owner Gaji screen renders employee cards and Catat Kasbon modal fields (kasbon-date, kasbon-amount, kasbon-note). Verified employee filter chips (Diterima/Cuci/Pengering/Setrika/Packing) switch without full-screen Loading blank and second-switch latency improved (~720ms vs ~1220ms first switch). Verified Antar Jemput tab opens. Dikerjakan card is borderless and click does not navigate.
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration 22 failure was due payroll SQL referencing invalid work_logs.kasbon_date and period deduction using created_at. Current code now filters work_logs by created_at (Asia/Jakarta date cast) and kasbon by kasbon_date, resolving the 500 and period-scoping behavior in regression tests.
